name: ES Initial Balance Break Analysis
description: Analyzes ES futures initial balance (IB) range on 1-min bars. IB = first 60 min of RTH (09:30–10:30 ET). Classifies days as narrow vs wide IB using 20-day rolling percentile rank of IB range (bottom 50% = narrow). For narrow IB days: (1) frequency of single vs dual IB extreme breaks, (2) probability of session close beyond a single broken level.
source:
# ES Initial Balance (IB) Break Analysis — 1-Min Bars
# IB = 09:30–10:30 ET. Narrow/Wide via 20-day rolling avg of IB range.
# Q1: On narrow days, how often does one vs both IB extremes break?
# Q2: After single-side break on narrow day, does session close beyond?

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1Min)()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

close = cont.c
high = cont.h
low = cont.l

# --- Session Windows ---
# IB: first 60 minutes of RTH
ib = session_window(session=Session(start='09:30', end='10:30', tz='America/New_York'))(
    open=cont.o, high=cont.h, low=cont.l, close=cont.c
)

# Full RTH session
rth = session_window(session=Session(start='09:30', end='16:00', tz='America/New_York'))(
    open=cont.o, high=cont.h, low=cont.l, close=cont.c
)

# --- IB Levels (persist within day after IB closes) ---
ib_high = ffill_day(where(ib.closed, ib.high))
ib_low = ffill_day(where(ib.closed, ib.low))
ib_range_sparse = where(ib.closed, ib.high - ib.low)

# Persist IB range within day for classification
ib_range = ffill_day(ib_range_sparse)

# IB has closed for the day (post-IB period)
ib_done = is_valid(ib_high)

# --- Narrow/Wide Classification ---
# Downsample sparse IB range to daily, compute 20-day percentile rank, upsample back
ib_range_daily = downsample(target_timeframe=1D, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(ffill(ib_range_sparse))
ib_pctrank_daily = percentrank(period=20)(ib_range_daily)
ib_pctrank = upsample(target_timeframe=1Min, how=FillMethod.ffill)(ib_pctrank_daily)

# Narrow = bottom 50% of recent IB ranges (percentrank < 50)
is_narrow = is_valid(ib_range) and is_valid(ib_pctrank) and (ib_pctrank < 50)

# --- Track IB Breaks During Post-IB RTH ---
# After IB closes, did price break above IB high or below IB low?
# hold_until: once broken, stays broken until next RTH session opens

high_break_pulse = ib_done and (high > ib_high) and not ib.active
broke_ib_high = hold_until()(enter=high_break_pulse, exit=rth.opened)

low_break_pulse = ib_done and (low < ib_low) and not ib.active
broke_ib_low = hold_until()(enter=low_break_pulse, exit=rth.opened)

# --- Classify Break Type at RTH Close ---
# rth.closed fires once on last bar of RTH session
# ib_done ensures IB completed (implicitly RTH opened)
is_rth_close = rth.closed and ib_done

# Safe boolean checks for broke flags (may be NaN before first break)
did_break_high = is_valid(broke_ib_high) and broke_ib_high
did_break_low = is_valid(broke_ib_low) and broke_ib_low

# Break classification
both_broke = did_break_high and did_break_low
high_only = did_break_high and not did_break_low
low_only = did_break_low and not did_break_high
neither_broke = not did_break_high and not did_break_low

# Narrow day at RTH close
is_narrow_day = is_rth_close and is_narrow

# --- Q1: Break Pattern Frequencies on Narrow Days ---
# Dense 0/1 flags filtered to narrow days only (NaN elsewhere)
narrow_high_only = 1.0 if (is_narrow_day and high_only) else (0.0 if is_narrow_day else 0.0 / 0.0)
narrow_low_only = 1.0 if (is_narrow_day and low_only) else (0.0 if is_narrow_day else 0.0 / 0.0)
narrow_both = 1.0 if (is_narrow_day and both_broke) else (0.0 if is_narrow_day else 0.0 / 0.0)
narrow_neither = 1.0 if (is_narrow_day and neither_broke) else (0.0 if is_narrow_day else 0.0 / 0.0)

# --- Q2: Close Beyond Broken Level on Single-Break Narrow Days ---
rth_close_price = rth.close
close_above_ib_high = is_valid(rth_close_price) and (rth_close_price > ib_high)
close_below_ib_low = is_valid(rth_close_price) and (rth_close_price < ib_low)

# Single high break on narrow day: close beyond?
narrow_high_close_beyond = 1.0 if (is_narrow_day and high_only and close_above_ib_high) else (0.0 if (is_narrow_day and high_only) else 0.0 / 0.0)

# Single low break on narrow day: close beyond?
narrow_low_close_beyond = 1.0 if (is_narrow_day and low_only and close_below_ib_low) else (0.0 if (is_narrow_day and low_only) else 0.0 / 0.0)

# Combined single-break close-beyond rate
is_single_break_narrow = is_narrow_day and (high_only or low_only)
single_break_close_beyond = 1.0 if (is_single_break_narrow and ((high_only and close_above_ib_high) or (low_only and close_below_ib_low))) else (0.0 if is_single_break_narrow else 0.0 / 0.0)

# --- Output 1: Break Pattern Bar Chart (Q1) ---
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='Narrow IB Days: How Often Does Each Break Pattern Occur?',
    category='IB Analysis',
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    x_axis_label='Break Type',
    data_labels=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='High Only', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Low Only', color=Color.Slate),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Both', color=Color.Orange),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Neither', color=Color.Gray)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.25, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='25% (Equal)')
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=(narrow_high_only, narrow_low_only, narrow_both, narrow_neither))

# --- Output 2: Close-Beyond Hit Rate (Q2) ---
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='Single IB Break on Narrow Day: Does Price Close Beyond?',
    category='IB Analysis',
    y_axis_label='Close-Beyond Rate',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    x_axis_label='Break Direction',
    data_labels=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Upside Break', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Downside Break', color=Color.Slate),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Any Single Break', color=Color.Cyan)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='50% (Coin Flip)')
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=(narrow_high_close_beyond, narrow_low_close_beyond, single_break_close_beyond))

# --- Output 3: Summary Table ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='IB Analysis',
    order=3,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Narrow IB Day Key Statistics',
        row_size=6,
        col_size=1,
        row_headers=['Narrow IB Days (N)', 'High-Only Break %', 'Low-Only Break %', 'Both Extremes Break %', 'Neither Breaks %', 'Single Break Close-Beyond %'],
        col_headers=['Value'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=5, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    )
)(narrow_high_only, narrow_high_only, narrow_low_only, narrow_both, narrow_neither, single_break_close_beyond)

# --- Event Markers: Narrow IB Break Events ---
break_label = conditional_select(
    is_narrow_day and high_only, "High Only",
    is_narrow_day and low_only, "Low Only",
    is_narrow_day and both_broke, "Both",
    is_narrow_day and neither_broke, "Neither",
    "N/A"
)

close_beyond_label = conditional_select(
    is_narrow_day and high_only and close_above_ib_high, "Yes",
    is_narrow_day and low_only and close_below_ib_low, "Yes",
    is_narrow_day and (high_only or low_only), "No",
    "N/A"
)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Narrow IB Day',
        icon=Icon.TargetIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Break Type', type=CardRenderType.TextFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Close Beyond?', type=CardRenderType.TextFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.SecondaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='IB Range (pts)', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Session Close', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(break_label, close_beyond_label, where(is_narrow_day, ib_range), where(is_narrow_day, rth.close), is_narrow_day)
